title: Psychology says children who hide behind parents around guests aren’t always shy
content: Children often hesitate to greet visitors, which can be more than mere shyness. It's vital for parents to grasp their child's emotions and the surrounding context. Creating a secure environment and allowing ample time can assist kids in adapting to new social environments. Pressuring them into socializing may lead to discomfort and impede their growth. Observation is key for distinguishing normal nervousness from genuine anxiety.

title: Scientists burn modern papyrus to help read 2,000-year-old Vesuvius scrolls

The innovative use of leaded ink was highlighted through X-ray scans, providing insights into fragile scrolls from Herculaneum.
